title: Two-Stage Finite-Scenario Stochastic GAP19 MILP Energy Optimization

scenarios.name: conservative_low_solar
scenarios.description: Calibrated q10 CQR lower envelope: max(0, q10_raw - q_hat)

scenarios.name: optimistic_high_solar
scenarios.description: Calibrated q90 CQR upper envelope with research boundary: max(lower, min(max(1.25*cs, F), q90_raw + q_hat))

formulation.weight_rationale: Symmetric, non-informative weighting representing the 80% conformal coverage interval [q10, q90] with 50% central mass and 25% tail allocations. Derived exclusively from pre-2024 calibration evidence. Zero 2024 parameter tuning.
formulation.physical_envelope_status: SIMULATED_RESEARCH_ASSUMPTION (Upper bound U = max(1.25*cs_ghi, F) is not production authorized)
first_stage_non_anticipative_variables: u_diesel[t]: binary diesel commitment (shared across scenarios)
v_start[t]: binary diesel startup (shared across scenarios)
p_diesel[t]: continuous diesel generation power (shared across scenarios)
u_chg[t]: binary battery charge mode (shared across scenarios)
u_dis[t]: binary battery discharge mode (shared across scenarios)
p_dis[t]: continuous battery discharge power (shared across scenarios)
p_wind_used[t]: continuous wind generation power dispatched (shared across scenarios)
p_chg_plan[t]: continuous planned battery charging power ceiling (shared across scenarios)
second_stage_recourse_variables: p_sol_used[t, s]: scenario-dependent solar power utilized
p_curt_sol[t, s]: scenario-dependent solar power curtailed
p_curt_wind[t, s]: scenario-dependent wind power curtailed
p_chg[t, s]: scenario-dependent realized battery charge (0 <= p_chg[t, s] <= p_chg_plan[t])
p_unmet[t, s]: scenario-dependent total demand deficit
P_unmet_crit[t, s]: scenario-dependent critical demand deficit
E_next[t, s]: scenario-dependent battery energy state transition
s_J2[t, s]: scenario-dependent governed reserve shortfall

lexicographic_objective_hierarchy.name: J1_expected_critical_deficit_wh
lexicographic_objective_hierarchy.definition: sum_s pi_s sum_t P_unmet_crit[t, s] * dt

lexicographic_objective_hierarchy.name: J3_first_stage_diesel_fuel_liters
lexicographic_objective_hierarchy.definition: sum_t (marg_fuel * p_diesel[t] + base_fuel * u_diesel[t] + startup_fuel * v_start[t]) * dt

lexicographic_objective_hierarchy.name: J4_expected_renewable_curtailment_wh
lexicographic_objective_hierarchy.definition: sum_s pi_s sum_t (p_curt_sol[t, s] + p_curt_wind[t, s]) * dt

five_arm_comparison_ladder.arm_a: Candidate F point forecast control (frozen production GAP19)
